name: The Pannonian theatre: the whole nation
description: The theatre with the whole nation on it (the nation on the map, N2): the briefing's forces, industry and infrastructure placed on the country's map (data/maps/pannonia.json) over the theatre the balance pass tuned (theatre_pannonia.json), which it extends.
notes: Fictional; positions are km east and north of the theatre's origin, on open ground of the country's map, and mobile units carry their prepared positions ("positions": they move between these). The forces follow the briefing (docs/campaign/10_BRIEFING_FORCES_AND_NATION.md §3-9) and its decisions: the S-75M2, the S-125M1, the Strela-10 platoons become Strela-1 platoons, the KS-30s round the capital, five Osa batteries, two motor rifle divisions with six regimental AA batteries, the tank brigade with the Kub. Our order of battle (data/command/oob_pannonia.json) owns every military object. Values, hardness, repair times and defences are game values like the base's; the balance has not been run on this theatre (N4, 13.8).

fronts.name: The north-eastern border with the Warsaw Pact

bases.notes: The Group of Forces' air bases beyond the border.

battery_position.notes: Battery 21 covers the approach to the Rava dam and the northern group with its AA, under the Pact's routes (the nation's theatre's first read, N4).

fronts.notes: force_scale 2: the Air Forces of the Front have two or three divisions of fighters and fighter-bombers (fm100_2_3 pp. 4-127 to 4-134); the faction's squadrons are one division's worth, sized for the tuned district. A war on the whole nation takes two, and its staff plans twice the packages a cycle (the nation on the map N4, docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 8). The cruise missiles' stocks are the long-range aviation's and do not scale.

battery_position.notes: Battery 21 covers the Dombas hub: the helicopter base, the army's artillery, rear base and materials depot, the Cegled junction, where NATO's raids into the centre cross (the nation's theatre's first read, N4).

fronts.notes: force_scale 1.5: a game value. An allied tactical air force commits more wings to a campaign against the whole nation than against a district; at 1.5 and at 2 the rollback is held back alike by the sites returning to service, not by the force (docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 8).
